english: Checking your reading…
We could not check your reading, so it was not sent. Your numbers are saved: try again.
kinyarwanda: Ntitwashoboye kugenzura igipimo cyanyu, bityo ntabwo cyoherejwe. Imibare yanyu irabitswe: ongera ugerageze.

english: This reading was just sent. Check your bills and messages before sending it again.
kinyarwanda: Iki gipimo kimaze koherezwa. Reba fagitire n'ubutumwa byanyu mbere yo kucyohereza bundi bushya.

english: Please check this reading
This is the first reading for your meter. An officer checks it once and records it as your starting point; your first bill comes with your next reading.
kinyarwanda: Iki ni cyo gipimo cya mbere cya mubazi yanyu. Umukozi wa WASAC aragigenzura rimwe akacyandika nk'aho tuzahera; fagitire ya mbere izaza n'igipimo gikurikira.

english: Your reading is lower than your previous accepted reading, {previous}. Meters only count up, so please check the digits.
kinyarwanda: Igipimo cyanyu kiri munsi y'igipimo giheruka kwemezwa, {previous}. Mubazi ibara izamuka gusa, bityo nimugenzure imibare.

english: This reading shows much more water than your home usually uses. Please check the digits. If they are right, you may have a leak.
kinyarwanda: Iki gipimo kigaragaza amazi menshi cyane kurusha ayo urugo rwanyu rusanzwe rukoresha. Nimugenzure imibare. Niba ari yo, mushobora kuba mufite amazi ameneka.

english: This reading is about ten times (or more) what your home usually uses, which often means a digit is in the wrong place. Please check the digits.
kinyarwanda: Iki gipimo kiruta incuro nk'icumi (cyangwa zirenga) ibyo urugo rwanyu rusanzwe rukoresha, akenshi bivuze ko umubare uri ahatari ho. Nimugenzure imibare.

english: Your reading is lower than the numbers we read in your photo. Please check the digits against your meter.
kinyarwanda: Igipimo cyanyu kiri munsi y'imibare twasomye ku ifoto yanyu. Nimugereranye imibare na mubazi yanyu.

english: We could not confirm this photo was taken at your meter (for example, your phone did not share its location, or the photo came from your gallery).
kinyarwanda: Ntitwashoboye kwemeza ko iyi foto yafatiwe kuri mubazi yanyu (urugero, telefoni yanyu ntiyatanze aho iri, cyangwa ifoto yavuye mu mafoto abitswe).

english: This reading suggests your meter passed its highest number and started again from zero. Please check the digits.
kinyarwanda: Iki gipimo kigaragaza ko mubazi yanyu yarenze umubare wayo munini igatangira bundi bushya kuri zeru. Nimugenzure imibare.

english: If the reading is correct, you can send it for review. An officer will check it before any bill.
kinyarwanda: Niba igipimo ari cyo, mushobora kucyohereza ngo kigenzurwe. Umukozi wa WASAC azakigenzura mbere ya fagitire iyo ari yo yose.

english: Check the digits
Send for review
This is your meter's first reading.
kinyarwanda: Iki ni cyo gipimo cya mbere cya mubazi yanyu.

english: It is lower than your previous accepted reading.
It shows much more water than your home usually uses.
kinyarwanda: Kigaragaza amazi menshi cyane kurusha ayo urugo rwanyu rusanzwe rukoresha.

english: It is far above what your home usually uses.
kinyarwanda: Kiri hejuru cyane y'ibyo urugo rwanyu rusanzwe rukoresha.

english: It is lower than the numbers we read in your photo.
kinyarwanda: Kiri munsi y'imibare twasomye ku ifoto yanyu.

english: We could not confirm where the photo was taken.
Your meter seems to have started again from zero.
kinyarwanda: Mubazi yanyu isa n'iyatangiye bundi bushya kuri zeru.

Credit used
Balance
You have {amount} of credit. It goes towards your next bills.
kinyarwanda: Mufite {amount} asigaye kuri konti. Azakoreshwa kuri fagitire zikurikira.

english: A reading far above your usual use
The reading you sent on {date} is about ten times (or more) what your home usually uses. That usually means a digit was read in the wrong place, so an officer will check it before your bill.
kinyarwanda: Igipimo mwohereje ku wa {date} kiruta incuro nk'icumi (cyangwa zirenga) ibyo urugo rwanyu rusanzwe rukoresha. Akenshi bivuze ko umubare wasomwe nabi, bityo umukozi wa WASAC azakigenzura mbere ya fagitire yanyu.

english: Your first reading
The reading you sent on {date} is the first one for your meter. An officer checks it once and records it as your starting point. Your first bill comes with your next reading.
kinyarwanda: Igipimo mwohereje ku wa {date} ni cyo cya mbere cya mubazi yanyu. Umukozi wa WASAC aragigenzura rimwe akacyandika nk'aho tuzahera. Fagitire ya mbere izaza n'igipimo gikurikira.

english: We're comparing your reading with the photo
The reading you sent on {date} is lower than the numbers we read in your photo. That can happen when our reading is wrong, so an officer will compare the two before your bill.
kinyarwanda: Igipimo mwohereje ku wa {date} kiri munsi y'imibare twasomye ku ifoto yanyu. Ibyo bishobora kubaho iyo twasomye nabi, bityo umukozi wa WASAC azabigereranya mbere ya fagitire yanyu.

english: Your meter seems to have started again from zero
kinyarwanda: Mubazi yanyu isa n'iyatangiye bundi bushya kuri zeru

english: The reading you sent on {date} suggests your meter passed its highest number and started again from zero. An officer will check it before your bill.
kinyarwanda: Igipimo mwohereje ku wa {date} kigaragaza ko mubazi yanyu yarenze umubare wayo munini igatangira bundi bushya kuri zeru. Umukozi wa WASAC azakigenzura mbere ya fagitire yanyu.

english: Checked and recorded as your starting point. Your first bill comes with your next reading.
kinyarwanda: Cyagenzuwe kandi cyanditswe nk'aho tuzahera. Fagitire ya mbere izaza n'igipimo gikurikira.

kinyarwanda: Hafi incuro 10 z'ibisanzwe: umubare wasomwe nabi?

kinyarwanda: Igipimo cya mbere: nta ho guhera hari

kinyarwanda: Mubazi yatangiye bundi bushya kuri zeru

kinyarwanda: Ifoto ntigaragara neza: hakenewe indi foto

english: The digits do not match the photo
The photo is not of this meter
Another reason
The reason
Reject the reading
This meter has no starting reading yet. Accepting records this reading as the starting point, with no bill. Rejecting asks the household for a new photo.
kinyarwanda: Iyi mubazi nta gipimo cyo guheraho ifite. Kwemeza byandika iki gipimo nk'aho guhera, nta fagitire. Kwanga bisaba urugo kohereza indi foto.

english: Recorded {name}'s first reading as the starting point. No bill until the next reading.
kinyarwanda: Igipimo cya mbere cya {name} cyanditswe nk'aho guhera. Nta fagitire kugeza ku gipimo gikurikira.

english: Correct a billed reading
For a reading that was billed and later found wrong. The bill and payments stay as they are; a linked adjustment changes the balance, and overpayments become credit.
kinyarwanda: Ku gipimo cyishyuwe nyuma bikagaragara ko cyari kibi. Fagitire n'ubwishyu bigumaho uko biri; ikosorwa rifatanye na fagitire rihindura asigaye, naho amafaranga arenze ahinduka asigaye kuri konti.

english: Bill
Choose a bill
The right reading (m³)
Show the effect
Choose a bill, type the right reading and say why (5 letters or more).
kinyarwanda: Hitamo fagitire, andika igipimo nyacyo kandi uvuge impamvu (inyuguti 5 cyangwa zirenga).

english: Bill {id}: {before} → {after} m³, {from} → {to}
Net change: {amount}
This charges more on a bill, so another supervisor or admin must approve it.
kinyarwanda: Ibi byongera amafaranga kuri fagitire, bityo undi mugenzuzi cyangwa umuyobozi agomba kubyemeza.

english: Ask for approval
Apply the correction
The correction is applied. The household has been told.
Saved. Another supervisor or admin must approve it.
kinyarwanda: Byabitswe. Undi mugenzuzi cyangwa umuyobozi agomba kubyemeza.

english: {name}, asked for by {by}:
{from} → {to} m³
Someone else must decide a correction you asked for.
kinyarwanda: Undi muntu agomba gufata icyemezo ku ikosorwa wasabye.

Decline
Why decline it?
Approved and applied. The household has been told.
Declined. Nothing was changed.
Paid twice: this bill was already paid, so the extra payment is kept as the household's credit for its next bills.
kinyarwanda: Yishyuwe kabiri: iyi fagitire yari yarishyuwe, bityo amafaranga y'inyongera abikwa kuri konti y'urugo agakoreshwa kuri fagitire zikurikira.
